name: james-games-monolith
description: Games4James monorepo: player web app, backend API and admin console.

scripts.build: npm run web:build && npm run admin:build && npm run backend:build
scripts.local:server: DATABASE_URL=pglite:.local/db FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9099 FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=demo-games4james npm run dev --workspace apps/backend-api
scripts.local:web: VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9099 VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=demo-games4james VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=localhost VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY=demo-key VITE_FIREBASE_APP_ID=demo-app VITE_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8787 npm run dev --workspace apps/player-web
scripts.local:admin: VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9099 VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=demo-games4james VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=localhost VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY=demo-key VITE_FIREBASE_APP_ID=demo-app VITE_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8787 npm run dev --workspace apps/admin-web
